candidates.violated_requirement: The shift register should retain the 8 most recent bits of input 'a', but the mutation causes it to retain only the 7 most recent bits plus the new input. This will cause incorrect matching behavior when the pattern 8'b0111_0001 appears in the input stream.
candidates.spec_basis: The module should implement an 8-bit shift register that shifts in the input 'a' on every positive edge of the clock.
